name: Maokai
title: the Twisted Treant

Q.name: Bramble Smash
Q.description: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing 75/120/165/210/255 + 0.5×AP plus 2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5% max Health magic damage and briefly Slowing. Nearby enemies are also Knocked Back.
Q.summary: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

W.name: Twisted Advance
W.description: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he Roots the enemy for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4 second(s) and deals 60/85/110/135/160 + 0.4×AP magic damage.
W.summary: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

E.name: Sapling Toss
E.description: Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for 30 seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal 50/75/100/125/150 + BaseApRatio×AP + 0.05×bonus max HP magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by 45% for 2 seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster. If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for 30 + 0.015×bonus max HP seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing 100/150/200/250/300 + 0.5×AP + 0.1×bonus max HP magic damage over 2 seconds and Slowing enemies by 0.45 + 0.0×AP + (0.01 × 0.01)×bonus max HP.
E.summary: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

R.name: Nature's Grasp
R.description: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, Rooting enemies for 0.75 to 2.25 seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing 150/225/300 + 0.75×AP magic damage. Hitting a champion gives Maokai 40/50/60% Move Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.
R.summary: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

Passive.name: Sap Magic
Passive.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.
Passive.summary: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tank who engages with an untargetable W root and controls fights with saplings and R wave. His passive heals him on attack.
strengths: W is an untargetable dash that roots
profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: he can't engage.
